about: Built by tools/build_state_of_nations.py from data/<nation>.json (coverage, guarantees, capital.register) and data/capital-architecture.json. Read by perfectnations.org/state-of-nations/ on every visit. Adds no fact: change a figure in its nation file, then rebuild.

standards.head: Pay before the harvest fails.
standards.name: Sovereign drought insurance
standards.ffd: Parametric cover pays on measured rainfall, so food reaches families within weeks of a failed season, without waiting for an appeal.

proof.label: paid out after the El Niño drought, for food aid to about 235,000 households

standards.si: SI reads rainfall, harvests and food prices district by district, sets the trigger and prices the cover before the season begins.

standards.head: Turn cheaper debt into safe water.
standards.name: Debt-for-climate-resilience swap
standards.ffd: Guarantees replace costly debt with cheaper debt, and the savings are committed to water and sewerage.
standards.si: SI maps every household without safe water at home, prices each connection, and follows the savings into every main and treatment plant.
standards.first: a debt-for-resilience swap bound to water

standards.head: Ring-fence bond money for homes and sanitation.
standards.name: Social bond
standards.ffd: The proceeds can be spent only on eligible homes, toilets and sewers, reported to investors every year.
standards.si: SI finds the homes without a safe toilet, groups them into programmes investors can finance, and reports each unit delivered.
standards.first: a social bond for homes and sanitation

standards.head: Finance clean power and clean cooking at national scale.
standards.name: Sovereign green bond
standards.ffd: Bond money ring-fenced for clean energy under a published framework, with every allocation reported to investors.
standards.si: SI counts the households still cooking with wood, charcoal or kerosene, prices the switch per home, and tracks every project the bond pays for.
standards.first: a sovereign green bond for clean power and cooking

standards.head: Pay for learning, not only for classrooms.
standards.name: Program-for-Results
standards.ffd: Each tranche of the loan is released only when pupils reach an agreed learning level, verified independently.
standards.si: SI tracks reading levels school by school, sets the targets that release each tranche, and flags the schools falling behind.

standards.head: Let lower debt costs pay for care.
standards.name: Debt-for-health guarantee
standards.ffd: A development bank guarantee cuts the cost of existing debt, and the savings are bound to the health system before they can be spent elsewhere.

proof.label: IDB guarantee, 20 years; about US$160 million of the savings for health care

standards.si: SI prices the essential services each citizen lacks, finds the costly debt to refinance, and follows every saving into clinics and care.

standards.head: Let local banks lend to the enterprises that hire.
standards.name: Small-business credit guarantee
standards.ffd: A facility guarantees most of each small-business loan, so local banks lend to firms they would otherwise turn away.
standards.si: SI matches enterprises to lenders, prices the risk the guarantee must carry, and counts the jobs each loan creates.
